source.authority: Philco factory schematic; source document remains the wiring authority

native_scan.derivative_note: SHA-256 identifies the reviewed 300-dpi page raster generated from the Philco PDF, not the publisher PDF bytes.

milestones.title: Power and heater source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked three filter/return groups, four documented heater interconnections and two #30 40 Ω/lamp shunt groups; confirmed #26:a on the first B+ group. AC endpoints, rectifier anode and complete line/heater path remain open.

milestones.title: Output-stage source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked the 7C6 plate, 50L6 grid/cathode, output-transformer primary and both speaker-secondary groups. #22/#25 routes and electrical transformer/speaker models remain open.

milestones.title: RF and converter source review
milestones.summary: Reviewed the p.38 antenna, loop, tuning, oscillator and 7A8 region. No new RF net was promoted: the 7A8 symbol-to-socket crosswalk and winding/gang terminal assignments need stronger source confirmation.

milestones.title: IF source review
milestones.summary: Cross-checked the three existing #12/#14 plate/grid memberships. Complete winding endpoints, 7B7 screen/cathode, trimmer and AVC routes remain open.

milestones.title: Detector/AVC and netlist integration review
milestones.summary: Rechecked four detector/audio conductor groups and the existing upper-diode symbol-level link. #17 lower branch, diode socket-pin assignment and full AVC/return routing remain open.

milestones.title: 50L6 cathode-bypass trace reconciliation
milestones.summary: Added capacitor #22 terminals to the cathode and B− net review from the dedicated v0.36 native-scan trace. The output transformer, #25 route, and full output model remain open.

milestones.title: Power and AC-line symbol-level closure
milestones.summary: Traced plug conductors, #16 switch, #31 line capacitor, #30 40/80-ohm sections, #32 pilot-lamp shunt, 35Z3 plate feed, B-minus return, and all five heaters. Pin/lug crosswalks remain open; no factory graph memberships were added.

milestones.title: Output bypass and IF primary supply-end trace
milestones.summary: Source-traced #25 across filtered B+ and B−, and #12/#14 primary supply ends to filtered B+. Screen-glyph routing is recorded without assigning socket pins; other IF/AVC/output model gaps remain open.

milestones.title: Second IF AVC load and detector return trace
milestones.summary: Added upper #14 secondary/#17 upper endpoint group and #17 lower return endpoint from the native page-38 scan. The linked upper 7C6 diode remains an unnumbered glyph; full AVC and socket crosswalk remain open.

milestones.title: First IF secondary return and grid-return resistor trace
milestones.summary: Traced #12 secondary return to B− and both #13 grid-return resistor ends to the #12 secondary/grid node and B−. Pin/winding crosswalks and IF model parameters remain open.

milestones.title: RF input and loop-operation ground trace
milestones.summary: Added the source-traced 7A8 signal-input conductor through the upper #3 loop terminal, RF gang #4 and aerial compensator #5, plus their explicit loop-mode chassis grounds. The lower loop/#2 winding map and rest of the converter remain open.

milestones.title: Built-in loop and aerial-transformer interface trace
milestones.summary: Traced both #2 winding endpoints, the lower #3 loop connection, external ANT input, #1 bypass path and its loop-mode chassis ground. Transformer parameters and the rest of the converter remain open.

milestones.title: 7A8 oscillator return endpoint trace
milestones.summary: Traced lower #9 resistor and #11 capacitor endpoints to the B− return rail. Their opposite ends, #4 gang, #6–#10 network and 7A8 socket-pin crosswalk remain open.
Traced the shared screen lead between V1:5 (7A8 G3/G5) and V2:3 (7B7 G2). Upstream supply and measurement conditions remain open.

milestones.title: 50L6 screen pin crosswalk and tube-supply correction
milestones.summary: Mapped the 50L6 screen glyph to pin 4 on filtered B+, closing the last wired 50L6 socket pin. Cross-checked v0.38: 7A8/7B7 screens belong to the separate shared 45 V lead, so the earlier screen-to-B+ glyph claims are retired; the upstream 45 V feed remains open.

milestones.title: Independent PT-44 oscillator alignment reference cross-check
milestones.source: Philco Complete Instructions for Adjusting All Philco Receivers, Volume 2, printed pp. xiii and 133
milestones.evidence: Confirms approximately 15-minute warm-up, 455 kHz IF alignment, #4 OSC at 1600 kHz, and #5 ANT at 1500 kHz for PT-42/PT-44.
milestones.scope_limit: Independent alignment corroboration does not trace #4 oscillator stator or #6–#11 endpoints, assign remaining 7A8 pins, or validate oscillator behavior.

milestones.title: 7A8 RF input series trap component #6 traced
milestones.source: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p.38; 400 dpi review rendering
milestones.evidence: Traces all four #6 terminals: condenser input on F_RF_INPUT, the condenser/choke series junction, and the choke output at the explicit loop-mode chassis ground.
milestones.scope_limit: Does not establish a chassis-to-B− bond, #4 oscillator gang routing, #7–#10 topology, remaining 7A8 pin assignments, or receiver behavior.

milestones.title: Loop return resistor #7 traced
milestones.source: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p.38; 400 dpi review rendering
milestones.evidence: Traces both #7 terminals: its upper lead joins the lower loop/#2 11-turn winding junction; its lower lead joins the B− rail.
milestones.scope_limit: Does not establish winding polarity or parameters, the #4 oscillator gang, remaining converter wiring, receiver behavior, or a chassis-to-B− bond.

milestones.title: Loop-secondary bypass capacitor #8 traced; factory value conflict logged
milestones.source: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p.38; 400 dpi review rendering
milestones.evidence: Traces both #8 capacitor terminals across the lower-loop/#2 11-turn junction and B−. The schematic marks 0.05 mfd, while the replacement-parts list specifies 0.1 mfd, 200 V, part 30-4499.
milestones.scope_limit: Connectivity is resolved at schematic-symbol/component-terminal level; the capacitor value conflict, #4 oscillator gang, #9–#11 converter paths, tube-pin mapping, winding parameters and receiver behavior remain open.

milestones.title: Oscillator tuning gang and left winding endpoint trace
milestones.source: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p.38; 400 dpi review rendering
milestones.evidence: Connects #4 oscillator gang signal plate to the upper left #10 winding, and its lower end to the explicit chassis ground symbol.
milestones.scope_limit: Provisional winding aliases do not assign transformer role, polarity, parameters, physical lugs or remaining converter paths.

milestones.title: 7A8 oscillator grid leak and shared-screen bypass trace
milestones.source: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book p.38; Sylvania 7A8 pin roles
milestones.evidence: #9 upper end joins 7A8 oscillator grid G1 (V1:4); #11 upper end joins the annotated shared 45 V screen conductor. Both lower ends were already traced to B−.
milestones.scope_limit: Four-dot oscillator contacts, opposite winding, upstream 45 V feed and measurement conditions, winding parameters and behavior remain open.

milestones.title: Power, switch and heater boundary pin crosswalk
milestones.source: Philco p.38 power-line drawing and tube basing references
milestones.evidence: Promotes #16, #30 and #31 endpoints plus 35Z3 plate/free heater and 7C6 end heater pin into source-reviewed electrical groups.
milestones.scope_limit: Plug polarity, physical switch lug numbering and physical heater lead orientation remain open; no chassis-to-B− bond.

milestones.title: Rider XII 12-45 oscillator anode cross-check
milestones.source: Philco p.38, Rider XII 12-45 and 7A8 basing
milestones.evidence: The 7A8 oscillator anode g2 pin V1:3 meets the upper right #10 winding end.
milestones.scope_limit: Lower winding end and #12/#13 conductor review still open; no physical lug/polarity or operation claim.

milestones.description: Correct supply/screen/AVC and passive-return conductors; trace lower #10 winding and five cathode/shield socket pins. Diode pin mapping remains open.
